Question: On the same set of axes are drawn the graph of \(y=ax^2+bx+c\) and the graph of the equation obtained by replacing \(x\) by \(-x\) in the given equation. If \(b\ne0\) and \(c\ne0\) these two graphs intersect:

Choices.A:
in two points, one on the \(x\)-axis and one on the
\(y\)-axis
Choices.B: in one point located on neither axis
